transfer.visualRole: supporting-component: dated milestone and history timeline anatomy for a credibility-forward institutional page
principles: Each timeline entry pairs one qualitative headline with two to four quantitative counters (employee count, contract value, client count) in the same card - proof is always paired numeric plus narrative, never adjective-only, which is exactly the model for restating UNIENS' registration, import, manufacturing, patent, and GMP timeline with its real registration numbers attached rather than as bare labels.
Milestones are ordered strictly chronologically with a persistent year marker as the primary scan anchor, reinforcing dated recency as the credibility signal itself.
Density is high, twelve stops, but each stop is visually terse: a title, one sentence, and numerals, avoiding paragraph-length history prose that would compete with the numeric proof.
